dropped.item: 'when they need it': the timeliness aspect of patients getting care was dropped

changed.item: 'Phone calls were hit or miss' became 'It mostly didn't work', a stronger negative judgment of phone calls
'The change was simple: we switched to text message reminders' became 'all we did was start texting people', which more strongly states that texting was the only change made
'care they need, when they need it' became 'care they came in for', which shifts the meaning (no-show patients by definition didn't come in)
'sometimes the biggest operational wins' became 'a lot of the biggest operational wins', a broader claim stated with more certainty
CTA 'it's worth testing' became 'try texts for a month and see what happens', adding a specific trial duration

added.item: 'The difference showed up quickly', a claim about how fast results appeared that is not in the original
'for a month' as a recommended trial length
